global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with visible bubbles, topped with tender chashu pork and chopped green onions. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a vibrant red surface under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: Red table surface has smooth texture, slight sheen, and curved edge visible beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth is creamy beige, thick, and bubbly, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with browned edges and visible fat marbling, glistening slightly from broth.
